_comment: Emulator config for the integration tests (npm run test:integration). The database and auth ports deliberately match firebase.json's, because src/app/firebase.ts hardcodes them when environment.useEmulators is set — which is what lets the DataStore integration spec exercise the app's own Firebase entry point instead of a mocked stand-in. If a dev emulator from `npm run emulators` is already holding those ports, emulators:exec refuses to start and the test run aborts, which is the safe outcome: these tests wipe the data they seed. Kept separate from firebase.json so no hosting or UI emulator is started for a run needing neither.
